name: Methamphetamine
warning: High-dose / sleep-deprived presentation. Uses peripheral flicker. Photosensitivity note applies.
tierNotes: Threshold: extra crispness — the over-sharpened vigilant look (early sharpenHalo); snow near-deniable (VSS density is quadratic in weight).
Light: fine visual snow appears on flat surfaces — sparse salt-and-pepper specks shimmering at a fixed ~14 Hz, not per-frame static.

Common: slow granular texture-crawl in FLAT regions only (edges/objects hold still) + first peripheral shadow blobs (slightly more frequent per user feedback) that emerge from the scene's own dark, high-contrast corners and vanish when the mouse (gaze) approaches.

Strong: frequent image-driven shadow events, harsh contrast, cold desaturation, denser snow, plus 'vibrating vision' waking up (fast constant eye-wiggle blur) and a nervous fast pattern-breathe on edges/textures, strong enough to be unmistakable — real structural distortion, deliberately fast/jittery rather than a slow psychedelic swell, so it stays restless/wired rather than trippy.

Heavy: rare humanoid silhouettes (p≈0.032/s, Heavy only) against whichever frame edge is darker, now with variety — standing, hunched-forward, or a low crouch, picked per event, instead of always the same shape; constant crawl + strong pattern-breathe on every edge in the frame; full salt-and-pepper snowstorm; strong vibrating-vision blur; rare 'Transformations' flicker (p≈0.02/s, Heavy only) where a high-edge object briefly mis-samples itself. Deliberately NOT psychedelic geometry/rainbow — PsychonautWiki's meth page doesn't document those as intrinsic effects.
